title: ASCII Kinesis V2 Locomotion 012 — Brake Debt / Support Cascade Repair

principle.name: BRAKING IS A SUPPORT CASCADE THAT SPENDS PRIOR VELOCITY
principle.summary: Braking anticipation occurs while speed remains high. A probe becomes a catch, the old support releases, COM visibly overruns and compresses that catch, a second catch accepts remaining debt, secondary masses overshoot, and recovery exits displaced rather than returning to idle.

source.identity: Sonic the Hedgehog — Sonic the Hedgehog — Sega Genesis
source.whole_sheet_evidence: Inherited predecessor evidence family: complete 690x1558 PNG previously inspected as one corpus including Basic Motion, Basic Motion (Angled), Full Speed, Full Speed (Angled), Skidding, Balance, Rolling/Jumping, Pushing, pipe/tunnel, hurt/death/continue, ending, and unused/prototype regions. Repair reuses that evidence family; source-authentic exposure timing remains unavailable.
source.rights_boundary: Copyright-restricted commercial-game sprite art used as evidence only. No source pixels, palette, contours, costume, proportions, sheet layout, frame arrangement, tracing, choreography, redistribution, or close imitation enters this successor. Output is independently authored abstract ASCII.

OBSERVED: TSR identity and asset 21628 source family inherited from rejected predecessor.
Whole-sheet evidence family includes fast/full-speed travel and distinct skidding/braking and balance/recovery regions.
Static sheet does not establish source-authentic decisive-key exposure timing.
INFERRED: All successor ASCII poses, support ownership, probe/catch chronology, COM/root spacing, compression depth, overshoot, counter-travel, recovery debt, and every timing class.
UNKNOWN: Source-authentic exposure duration, exact engine playback cadence, exact source root coordinates, force magnitudes, and chronology between sheet cells.

timing_policy.name: STREET_FIGHTER/CAPCOM
timing_policy.note: ONES/TWOS/FOURS are timing classes, never seconds. Every decisive key is INFERRED.

keys.name: FAST_ENTRY
keys.causal_role: committed travel enters already owing momentum
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=10; established fast travel begins before any braking choice
keys.attitude: forward bite: low root, head ahead, arms split

keys.name: LEFT_TOE_RELEASE
keys.causal_role: rear support extends and prepares to release
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=13; +3 while left support extends to the edge of its useful range
keys.attitude: long forward spear; support leg straightens before flight

keys.name: FLIGHT_COMMIT
keys.causal_role: brief unsupported phase carries established velocity into the next catch
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=15; +2 with no ground owner; both feet visibly clear before right catch
keys.attitude: body stretched forward in a short flight; limbs scissor instead of swapping magically

keys.name: RIGHT_CATCH_FAST
keys.causal_role: fast right-foot catch after a brief authored flight phase
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=17; right foot earns the next support after visible release/flight, preserving fast-travel phase continuity
keys.attitude: hard right-foot catch with opposite arm drive; still accelerating into the coming brake read

keys.name: BRAKE_ANTICIPATION
keys.causal_role: braking intention appears before deceleration
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=24; another +7 while torso counterleans; anticipation spends no velocity by itself
keys.attitude: hips continue forward while chest/head hang back; both arms spear toward impending catch

keys.name: LEFT_PROBE
keys.causal_role: front foot tests ground without owning the root
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=30; +6 while old right support remains root owner
keys.attitude: long split: pelvis outruns rear support; searching foot reaches far ahead

keys.name: LEFT_CATCH
keys.causal_role: first arrest support becomes trustworthy while old support still exists
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=35; +5 after catch, visibly still carrying momentum
keys.attitude: wide two-point arrest triangle; chest remains rearward while catch foot bites

keys.name: OLD_FOOT_RELEASE
keys.causal_role: old support releases only after new support is trustworthy
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=38; +3; ownership fully transfers to left catch
keys.attitude: rear foot peels while root piles over front support

keys.name: DEEP_ABSORB_A
keys.causal_role: first catch compresses under remaining COM debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=40; +2 and one row lower; support arrests vertical and horizontal debt together
keys.attitude: crooked fold over left catch; free leg whips forward; head still late

keys.name: COUNTERSWING_A
keys.causal_role: upper body and arms swing through after root compression
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=41; +1; root almost checked while secondary mass keeps traveling
keys.attitude: support stays fixed; chest rises, arms whip behind, free knee remains forward

keys.name: RIGHT_SEARCH
keys.causal_role: second foot searches while first support still owns the root
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=43; +2 after rebound; right foot descends toward a new catch
keys.attitude: head leads again but arms lag; searching leg lengthens

keys.name: RIGHT_PROBE
keys.causal_role: second foot touches as probe without premature ownership
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=44; +1; first support still owns COM
keys.attitude: front toe tests while pelvis remains compressed behind it

keys.name: RIGHT_CATCH
keys.causal_role: second catch becomes trustworthy before first support releases
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=45; +1 and drops into a second arrest
keys.attitude: two-point catch with opposite torso pitch; feet do not freeze symmetrically

keys.name: LEFT_RELEASE
keys.causal_role: first catch releases after second support accepts load
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=47; +2; right support now owns remaining braking debt
keys.attitude: old left foot peels backward; torso continues forward

keys.name: TORSO_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: secondary masses overshoot the arrested pelvis
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=49; +2 while chest/head advance farther than root
keys.attitude: head and sternum spear past support; trailing arm stays late

keys.name: COUNTER_TRAVEL
keys.causal_role: support elasticity pulls root one unit back after overshoot
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=48; -1 authored counter-travel after overshoot, not reverse playback
keys.attitude: body folds back around fixed right foot; arms continue their own lag path

keys.name: LEFT_SEARCH_RECOVERY
keys.causal_role: recovery step begins from displaced braking state
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=50; +2; new travel grows from arrest instead of neutral reset
keys.attitude: torso still rear-biased while free left foot searches ahead

keys.name: LEFT_PROBE_RECOVERY
keys.causal_role: recovery foot probes before taking ownership
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=51; +1; right support remains trusted
keys.attitude: long low probe and opposite arm reach keep braking history visible

keys.name: LEFT_ACQUIRE_RECOVERY
keys.causal_role: recovery foot earns load and catches residual counter-motion
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=52; +1 and compresses into new support
keys.attitude: new foot catches while head/chest still trail; recovery is not neutral

keys.name: RIGHT_RELEASE_RECOVERY
keys.causal_role: right foot releases after recovery ownership transfer
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=54; +2; left support launches a displaced exit step
keys.attitude: hips move first; old catch foot peels; arms remain off-phase

keys.name: DISPLACED_STEP
keys.causal_role: braking debt resolves into a forward recovery stride, not idle
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=58; +4, slower than entry but deliberately moving
keys.attitude: recovery stride is long and asymmetric; old arm lag finally crosses

keys.name: EXIT_WITH_DEBT
keys.causal_role: end with next catch still owed
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis x=62; +4; sequence exits locomotor and displaced, not restacked idle
keys.attitude: head/root continue forward while right toe only probes the next support

compile.connective_policy: No generated interstitial geometry. All semantic transitions, support-owner changes, probe/catch states, compression, overshoot and counter-travel are authored decisive or bridge keys. Unsupported states fail closed.

history.correction: Inserted K0A LEFT_TOE_RELEASE and K0B FLIGHT_COMMIT before K1 RIGHT_CATCH_FAST.

history.basis: Decoded final render: support continuity, brake anticipation at speed, first catch compression, second catch cascade, secondary overshoot, authored counter-travel, displaced recovery debt all read; no generated connector invents ownership.
